description: This file defines a PHP interface named AccessPointArnInterface within the AWS SDK, under the namespace Aws\Arn. It extends another interface ArnInterface and declares a single method getAccesspointName().

classes.name: AccessPointArnInterface
classes.description: An interface that provides a method to retrieve the access point name within AWS ARN (Amazon Resource Name) representations.

methods.name: getAccesspointName
methods.description: Method to obtain the access point name as part of the ARN.
